question: Who is known as the father of genetics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gregor Mendel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gregor Mendel** is a **mathematician** and **biologist** from the Austrian Empire (now Czech republic).
 
• He is called as **Father of Genetics** for his **extensive research and observations** done on **pea plants and their characteristics**. 
 
• He **coined the terms recessive and dominant** and used **statistical models to learn the behaviour of the plant**.
 
• He developed **principles of inheritance** that explained the **transmission of genes**.
 
• **His observations** were later verified with experiments that **laid the foundation of the modern field of Genetics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Charles Darwin**

 
 
• He is an **English biologist.**
 
• He is known for his **work on the evolution of life** and the principles of the **Theory of natural selection.**
 
• He is the author of the **famous book “Origin of Species”**.
 
 
 
• **Robert Hook**
 
 
• He is an **English scientist and mathematician.**
 
• He is known for **using a microscope and observing a microorganism for the first time.**
 
• He also devised the equation describing elasticity which is known as **Hooke’s law.**
 
 
 
• **EP Odum**
 
 
• He is an **American biologist.**
 
• He is known for his **work and explaining the concept of the ecosystem.**
